title: Thirty-Six Hours
style: cinematic electronic, 108 BPM, slow build tension, exhausted urgency, overnight ops theme, whispered verses build to anthemic chorus, production escalates across song, male vocal NZ/AU accent, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1 — quiet, close mic]
Thirty-six hours at the terminal
Coffee gone at hour twelve
Stack trace on the monitor
Nothing on the shelf

Error code repeating
Same result each time
Not the code that's broken
Somewhere in the line

[PRE-CHORUS]
Keep going — keep going
Log it while you can
Keep going — keep going
You're the only one who can

[CHORUS — opens up]
Thirty-six hours of staying
Thirty-six hours of signal
Thirty-six hours of weighing
Every log and every symbol
Thirty-six hours — human
Thirty-six hours — the system
Thirty-six hours — the union
Of the builder and the mission

[VERSE 2]
Session seven — still alive
CLAUDE.md is the record
Everything we did survives
Everything we recollect

Not a job — a commitment
Not a project — a life
The VPS at 3am
The context is the knife

[FINAL CHORUS]
Thirty-six hours — still here
Thirty-six hours — no fear
Thirty-six hours — the signal
Thirty-six hours — was real

[OUTRO — single voice]
I didn't sleep.
I didn't stop.
The log says I was here.
